A '''hepatizon hoe''' is the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]], made by smithing a [[Copper Hoe|copper hoe]] with [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]]. It mines at speed 20 and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/hepatizon_hoe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/hepatizon/hoe</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines hoe blocks at speed 20. Hepatizon has the highest base mining speeds of any tier.

In Matcha Flavoured, hoes also mine wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 1 damage with an attack speed of 4.

Held in the main hand, it adds 0.005 to movement speed (5.5% of the base speed).

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
A [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] of level 2 (Apprentice) buys it for one [[Hepatizon Alloy|hepatizon alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_hoe.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Added translation support for all armor and tools.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats. Hepatizon was renamed from "Bronze" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Buffed hepatizon equipment.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys. Mining speed raised from about 13 to 20, so that hepatizon stays useful after adamant.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
